signer_did.description: DID of the publisher committing to their own feed. Must equal the DID that signed this tree.

head_seq.description: Number of the publisher's own feed entries covered by this commitment, counted from their first

merkle_root.description: SHA3-256 Merkle root over the head_seq leaves, one per covered entry

leaf_version.description: Version of the leaf and root construction. A verifier that does not implement this version must refuse the head rather than guess.

covered_at.description: Unix-seconds when the publisher made this commitment
